data.body:
INVESTIGATION: Root cause confirmed. Two symptoms share same SNAPSHOT-blindness structural defect.

Symptom 1 (unlink fails on orphan) — FIXED: Made reciprocal unlink best-effort in ticket-link.sh. When id2 has no reciprocal LINK (orphan/compacted state), warn and continue; primary unlink on id1 succeeds.

Symptom 2 (ticket edit creates orphan) — DEFERRED: _is_active_link in ticket_graph/_links.py, _is_duplicate_link and _get_link_info in ticket-link.sh are blind to *-SNAPSHOT.json files. When a LINK event is compacted into a SNAPSHOT, subsequent calls to add_dependency write a new LINK with a fresh UUID, creating the orphan state that triggers Symptom 1. This is a deeper fix requiring changes to ticket_graph/_links.py and ticket-link.sh Python heredocs. Recommend separate bug ticket.
